crossRefs.note: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

translations.web: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.
translations.bsb: At daybreak, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
translations.kjv: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
translations.asv: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
